scope: resolved_repair@1 on fixed two-cell/four-membrane-patch/five-exterior geometry, composing the qualified shared CaV/Kv1/NaV/HCN catalog and owned free cytosol/ER with prescribed patch injury and resealing. Four synthetic 50-us controls and a 50-us one-way assembly composition. This panel qualifies numerical integration, ownership, conservation, event timing, complete replay and CPU/L4 agreement in this bounded regime; it does not establish biological repair, longer-term recovery or full BETSE cutting equivalence.
checks: Four controls share the exact 5.3-us onset and 15.3-us offset grid: zero hazard, sham input, injury with closure disabled, and prescribed resealing. Only the first patch is injured. They are mechanism/numerical controls, not independent biological cases.

Analytic damage evolution, independent compact/padded stage rates, explicit Na/K free-ion ownership and field energy accounting. Injury remains independent of ordinary membrane/channel availability. Damage, opened/closed integrals, transferred ions and route heat are complete state; no clipping, resets or structural repair energy is assumed.

Complete 39-field JAX histories and physical observations for all four 50-us controls, compared with independent segmented DOP853 and full-node electrical roots. Complete arrays, definitions and signed reference errors are saved before numerical assertions. Both held/resealing references must remain stable after fourfold tightening of all ODE tolerances.

Held and resealing trajectories refine at 0.625/0.3125/0.15625 us with unchanged physical error budgets and the existing absolute roundoff floors. Each refinement input, history and signed error remains preserved, including failures.

Same-input repeat, no-injury/sham equivalence, exact off-grid event checkpoint, fresh-process complete-history continuation, terminal restart and changed execution windows. A future closure-disabled branch keeps the complete boundary state and leaves damage open; it does not erase chemical/electrical/gate history.

Independent worlds use different resealing controls and preserve their full scalar histories under batching, reversed ordering and saved independent-clock window continuation. These are routing/reproducibility checks, not biological replication.

Pure JAX union clock stops at both stochastic per-cell assembly events and scheduled interventions. Exact ties use preceding controls for the completed segment. Earlier constant-input behavior, checkpoint clock identity, resource budgets, stable world/patch/species ownership and invalid trial/state rejection are checked.

Assembly-regulated injury checks independently reconstruct protein events, compare all five registered ionic observations to the independent reference, and test complete checkpoint/window/partition replay. Assembly affects only declared shared channel populations; injury and closure remain externally prescribed.

CPU/L4 comparisons cover all ordinary histories and observations plus complete coupled states at the five assembly observation boundaries. Coulombs, amperes and volts retain distinct tolerances; controls/times and discrete event state remain exact. Required CPU reports are authenticated before GPU comparison by the existing runner.

Reference calculations and NumPy contract checks remain host work during both backend phases. Compiled rollout and guard checks assert device placement. One-to-sixteen-GPU planning preserves world identities but does not execute a remote GPU.

Run related tests serially in fresh bounded process groups. Preserve failed runs, strict test identity/count checks, all required evidence, frozen source, runtime identity and both GPU busy/SM-active metrics. No automatic retry or follow-up.
scope_exclusions: Manufactured concentrations, charge backgrounds, injury rates (20000/s), closure rates (4000/s) and fast assembly events; no fitted tissue repair times or experimental calibration.
Finite closed exterior and fixed geometry; only Na/K injury permeability. No instantaneous cut, cell deletion/replacement, remeshing, volume/flow, mechanics or regrowth.
Prescribed closure has no finite metabolic or structural material cost. Declining damage is not demonstrated physiological recovery or autonomous repair.
One-way neutral protein assembly controls shared channel availability; no assembly-driven closure or ionic/energy feedback into protein pools.
Ordinary injury observations include intervention boundaries; coupled observations/checkpoints remain on nominal ionic ticks while internal steps split exactly at interventions and assembly events.

Numerical/source correspondence within 50 us, not long-duration validation, full native BETSE tissue behavior, BITSEY reproduction or biological regeneration. The channel-compensation research remains parked.

Independent-world planning supports one to sixteen GPUs; actual multi-GPU and distributed single-tissue execution remain unqualified. GPU counters include compilation and host checks, with no warmed throughput gate.

prerequisite.scope: Completed CaV calibration prerequisite; new injury/assembly composition is checked afresh on CPU and L4
